summary: Elevate your negotiation skills in the oil and gas sector. Join our specialized training course to learn strategies that lead to successful deals.
lede: Oil and gas negotiation training helps commercial, legal, finance, procurement and project professionals prepare for high-stakes deal discussions. It covers mapping counterpart interests, setting priorities and walk-away points, planning concession strategies, and identifying value drivers across contract terms. Participants also practice responding to negotiation tactics, aligning commercial goals with legal wording, and shaping risk-sharing options for uncertain conditions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals engaged in oil and gas negotiations and commercial decision-making.
audience: Government and regulatory officials engaged in petroleum
National oil company and international oil company
modules: Strategic Context of Oil and Gas Negotiations
Deal Structures and Value Drivers in Oil and Gas
Commercial and Legal Terms in Oil and Gas Contracts
Managing Risk, Uncertainty and Price Volatility in Deals
Communicating, Closing and Implementing the Deal
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of the oil and gas industry and experience with contract negotiation or commercial roles.
